lessons.title: సంతోషపెట్టు (santōṣapeṭṭu) — to make happy; to please

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Telugu for to thrill, then the Telugu for cheerfulness.
సంతోషపెట్టు — santōṣapeṭṭu — "to make happy; to please".
పుట్టినరోజున అన్నయ్య అమ్మను సంతోషపెట్టాడు. puṭṭinarōjuna annayya ammanu santōṣapeṭṭāḍu. On her birthday my brother made mum happy.
Past (I …): సంతోషపెట్టాను, santōṣapeṭṭānu.
సంతోషం, happiness, + పెట్టు, to put: to make someone happy.
సంతోషపెట్టు (santōṣapeṭṭu) joins సంతోషం, from Sanskrit saṁtōṣa, "satisfaction" (CDIAL 12895), to the native verb peṭṭu, "to put".
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.

Before the new one: say the Telugu for cheerfulness, then the Telugu for to make happy.
ఆశ్చర్యపరచు — āścaryaparacu — "to surprise; to astonish".
ఆమె పాట అందరినీ ఆశ్చర్యపరిచింది. āme pāṭa andarinī āścaryaparicindi. Her song astonished everyone.
Past (I …): ఆశ్చర్యపరిచాను, āścaryaparicānu.
-పరచు makes a causative from a noun: ఆశ్చర్యం, surprise; ఆశ్చర్యపరచు (āścaryaparacu), to surprise someone.
ఆశ్చర్యపరచు (āścaryaparacu) is built from ఆశ్చర్యం, from Sanskrit āścarya, "wonderful" (CDIAL 1464) and paracu, which DEDR 3853 lists as "to cause to feel", the causative partner of paḍu.
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.

lessons.title: సత్కరించు (satkariñcu) — to honour formally; to felicitate

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Telugu for to make happy, then the Telugu for to surprise.
సత్కరించు — satkariñcu — "to honour formally; to felicitate".
బడిలో మంచి మార్కులు వచ్చిన విద్యార్థులను సత్కరించారు. baḍilō mañci mārkulu vaccina vidyārthulanu satkariñcāru. The school honoured the students who got good marks.
Past (I …): సత్కరించాను, satkariñcānu.
Honouring someone in public, often with a shawl and a garland. The noun is సత్కారం.
సత్కరించు (satkariñcu) is built on Sanskrit satkāra, "kind treatment, honour, hospitality" (Monier-Williams), from sat, "good", and kāra, "doing", with the Telugu verb ending -ఇంచు.
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.

lessons.title: మెప్పించు (meppiñcu) — to impress; to win approval

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Telugu for to surprise, then the Telugu for to honour formally.
మెప్పించు — meppiñcu — "to impress; to win approval".
ఆ పిల్లవాడు తన పాటతో అందరినీ మెప్పించాడు. ā pillavāḍu tana pāṭatō andarinī meppiñcāḍu. That boy impressed everyone with his song.
Past (I …): మెప్పించాను, meppiñcānu.
To do something so well that others praise you; మెప్పు is the praise you earn.
మెప్పించు (meppiñcu) is native Dravidian: DEDR 4722 lists Telugu meppincu, "to please, to satisfy, to win the approval or admiration of", beside meccu, "to praise", and meppu, "praise".
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.

lessons.title: ఉత్సాహపరచు (utsāhaparacu) — to cheer on; to enthuse

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Telugu for to honour formally, then the Telugu for to impress.
ఉత్సాహపరచు — utsāhaparacu — "to cheer on; to enthuse".
అమ్మ మాటలు నన్ను ఉత్సాహపరిచాయి. amma māṭalu nannu utsāhaparicāyi. Mum's words cheered me on.
Past (I …): ఉత్సాహపరిచాను, utsāhaparicānu.
ఉత్సాహం, enthusiasm, + -పరచు, to make someone feel it.
ఉత్సాహపరచు (utsāhaparacu) is built from ఉత్సాహం, from Sanskrit utsāha, "power, firmness; joy" (CDIAL 1882), and paracu, which DEDR 3853 lists as "to cause to feel".
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.

segments.text: Gloom? (దిగులు, digulu.) To worry? (చింతించు, cintiñcu.) To be agitated? (కలవరపడు, kalavarapaḍu.) To panic? (కంగారుపడు, kaṅgārupaḍu.) Eagerness? (ఆత్రుత, ātruta.) To be afraid? (భయపడు, bhayapaḍu.) To frighten? (భయపెట్టు, bhayapeṭṭu.) To be startled? (ఉలిక్కిపడు, ulikkipaḍu.) A nightmare? (పీడకల, pīḍakala.) To be distraught? (తల్లడిల్లు, tallaḍillu.) To feel sad? (బాధపడు, bādhapaḍu.) To hurt? (బాధపెట్టు, bādhapeṭṭu.) To be crushed? (కుంగిపోవు, kuṅgipōvu.) To grieve inwardly? (కుమిలిపోవు, kumilipōvu.) Despair? (నిస్పృహ, nispṛha.) To get angry? (కోప్పడు, kōppaḍu.) To flare up? (మండిపడు, maṇḍipaḍu.) To snap at? (కసురుకో, kasurukō.) Fury? (ఆవేశం, āvēśaṁ.) Irritation? (చిరాకు, cirāku.) Self-respect? (ఆత్మగౌరవం, ātmagauravaṁ.) Humiliation? (అవమానం, avamānaṁ.) To be proud? (గర్వపడు, garvapaḍu.) To hold back politely? (మొహమాటపడు, mohamāṭapaḍu.) To hang one's head? (తలదించుకో, taladiñcukō.) To be jealous? (అసూయపడు, asūyapaḍu.) To hate? (ద్వేషించు, dvēṣiñcu.) To loathe? (అసహ్యించుకో, asahyiñcukō.) A grudge? (పగ, paga.) Contempt? (చిన్నచూపు, cinnacūpu.) To enjoy? (ఆనందించు, ānandiñcu.) To be delighted? (మురిసిపోవు, murisipōvu.) To be overjoyed? (పొంగిపోవు, poṅgipōvu.) To thrill? (పులకించు, pulakiñcu.) Cheerfulness? (ఉల్లాసం, ullāsaṁ.) To make happy? (సంతోషపెట్టు, santōṣapeṭṭu.) To surprise? (ఆశ్చర్యపరచు, āścaryaparacu.) To honour formally? (సత్కరించు, satkariñcu.) To impress? (మెప్పించు, meppiñcu.) To cheer on? (ఉత్సాహపరచు, utsāhaparacu.)
